Overall, a great habit tracker if you want something simple, flexible, and not subscription-heavy.

title: THIS APP IS THE ONE 💳💥💳💥💳💥
body:
Here's my guide, crafted from personal experience and tailored to those, like me, who struggle with staying on top of their to-do list. It might not suit everyone, but it's been a GAME-CHANGER for me. 

Firstly, I rely on a MIX of productivity apps: Google Calendar keeps me on track with important dates, the Weekly Planner helps me navigate my week, and the Habit Tracker serves as my trusty sidekick.

1. Think of it as a game. Whenever a new task pops up, I JOT IT DOWN in a specific 'brain dump' space—nothing fancy, just easy access, like saved messages.

2. Then comes the PLAN / SCHEDULE phase. I roughly slot tasks into my Weekly Planner, ensuring I have a clear view of my week WITHOUT getting bogged down by specific and fixed timeline. 

3. Finally, it's all about EXECUTION. I use Google Calendar to organize my daily planner either in the morning or night before. Just please dont plan your EVERY hour as you know you are not gonna follow it 🤦🏻‍♀️ THIS APP IS PERFECT for this final step, as it separates my habits from my 'brain dump' tasks, allowing me to focus on what matters most while doing side-quest thingy.

This daily planning routine keeps me hyper-aware of my priorities and allows for flexibility to match my daily activities. Building habits takes time, and missing one day doesn't derail the whole plan. With this approach, I've found joy in productivity, rather than just checking off habits while the TASKS pile up and stress me out at the end of the day, month, and my whole life.
